suppliers.name: Boliden Kokkola
suppliers.evidence: Current zinc page identifies Kokkola, Finland, and links SHG specification; linked 2018 technical sheet states 99.995% and ingot formats. Technical-sheet age is not a current quote date.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Public zinc sales manager and get-in-touch links. Request Kokkola allocation, dated assay and shipment origin; no order accepted.

suppliers.name: SSAB Europe Oy — Raahe
suppliers.evidence: Raahe site describes hot-rolled plate and strip production with coil slitting and cut-to-length. Coil grade, width, mill allocation and origin certificate require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official locations page identifies SSAB Europe Oy in Raahe and Finnish sales telephone.

suppliers.name: BE Group Oy Ab
suppliers.evidence: Finnish product portfolio includes hot/cold-rolled sheets and coils; full, unslit carbon HRC supply in required dimensions must be confirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Finnish headquarters, phone, email, customer registration and webshop/sales ordering route published.

suppliers.name: Feon Oy
suppliers.evidence: Current sheets/coils page offers hot-rolled strip-derived sheets. Full HRC rather than cut-to-length material is not established; Finnish distributor imports mainly European steel.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official contact page provides wholesale/project sales and company contact routes.

suppliers.name: Boliden Odda
suppliers.evidence: Current zinc page and Odda site identify Norwegian zinc production; linked SHG technical sheet is dated 2018 and specifies 99.995%. Do not interpret it as current allocation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Group zinc sales channel published; request Odda-specific allocation and origin evidence.

suppliers.name: Norex International AB
suppliers.evidence: Offers non-prime hot-rolled coils, sheets and plates from Scandinavian/European mills. Non-prime material needs explicit buyer approval and lot-specific inspection.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Swedish headquarters and public contact form; webshop registration/approval required for quotation access.

suppliers.name: SSAB EMEA AB — Borlange
suppliers.evidence: Official production-sites page identifies Swedish hot/cold-rolled high-strength strip operations. Buyer grade and coil dimensions still require a mill quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official group locations/contact directory provides Swedish company address and telephone; allocation must be confirmed.

suppliers.name: Wilhelm Grillo Handelsgesellschaft mbH
suppliers.evidence: Current trading programme lists zinc. Detailed product link could not be retrieved; this record does not establish current 99.995% ingot availability. LME screen is not an offer.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official Duisburg trading company address and inquiry/contact form published; request SHG ingot specification.

suppliers.name: ESB European Steel Business Germany GmbH
suppliers.evidence: Portfolio explicitly includes hot-rolled micro-alloyed steels and supply of coils/slit strip. Exact commercial grade, coil dimensions and mill origin require a quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Moers headquarters, telephone and business email published; project inquiries invited.

suppliers.name: A.M.P.E.R.E. Industrie SAS
suppliers.evidence: Product page specifies SHG zinc ingots above 99.995% in approximately one-tonne bundles. Undated in-stock wording is not a current stock confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: French sales/export department telephone, addresses and inquiry form published.

suppliers.name: thyssenkrupp Steel France SAS
suppliers.evidence: French sales-company section explicitly markets flat carbon steel including black or pickled hot-rolled coils. French seller location does not mean French-melted steel.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Elancourt address and named industry-sales contact telephone/email link published.

suppliers.name: Italchimici SpA
suppliers.evidence: Markets SHG zinc ingots, minimum 99.995%, including LME-registered brands. Ingot brand, origin and available tonnage must be confirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official request-information form and Lumezzane, Italy address/telephone inspected.

suppliers.name: L.T. Lamiere Tagliate SpA
suppliers.evidence: Explicit hot-rolled pickled/oiled low-carbon coil range, with EN 10111, EN 10025 and EN 10149-2 product families.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Limena, Italy company address, phone/email and invitation to request quotes published.

suppliers.name: ATZ Trading
suppliers.evidence: Lists HRC separately from other steel products; exact carbon grade and manufacturer are not stated. Supplier qualification remains necessary.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Bellinzona, Switzerland address, telephone, email and message form published.

suppliers.name: REFERRO BV
suppliers.evidence: Offers hot-rolled flat steel in coils, slit coils, sheets and plates, dry or pickled. Exact grade, prime/non-prime condition and origin require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Antwerp company address, Belgian VAT identifier, named business emails and inquiry link published.

suppliers.name: Nyrstar Budel
suppliers.evidence: Current Budel operations page lists special-high-grade zinc and zinc alloys. Request SHG ingot specification, current production allocation and origin certificate.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Budel, Netherlands site address and public corporate telephone/message route published; sales routing not tested.

suppliers.name: Orbital Trading BV
suppliers.evidence: Explicit hot-rolled coil range; business emphasizes secondary/surplus and non-prime material. Exact carbon grade, defects and mill origin require lot-level validation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Amsterdam address, telephone, business email and contact links published.

suppliers.name: Amalgamet Ltd
suppliers.evidence: Explicit LME-registered SHG 99.995 zinc ingots. Worldwide warehousing claim does not establish a UK-origin shipment or today’s stock.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Registered London address and Enquire Now link to official contact page inspected.

suppliers.name: CoreMet Steel — EDTO Global Ltd
suppliers.evidence: Publishes carbon HRC grades including S235JR/S355JR and DD11/DD12, as-rolled or pickled/oiled, with specifications subject to order requirements. This is supplier self-description, not independent qualification.
suppliers.contact_evidence: UK office address, sales email/phone and quotation inquiry form published; legal-entity/bank validation still required.

suppliers.name: P.H.U. Jan-Pol Maciej Wajszczuk
suppliers.evidence: Explicit offer of SHG zinc to EN 1179, minimum 99.995%, as ingots/jumbos. Also handles lower-purity residues; RFQ must exclude those alternatives.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Torun, Poland company address, tax identifier and business email published.

suppliers.name: Huta Cynku Miasteczko Slaskie SA
suppliers.evidence: Offers SHG Z1 zinc 99.995%, approximately 25kg slabs and jumbo forms. Lot-specific specification and production allocation require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Sales department telephone/email and office hours are published on the offer page.

suppliers.name: ArcelorMittal Poland
suppliers.evidence: Hot-rolled-coil product section with product-card link. Grade, dimensions, origin and capacity allocation require dated confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Krakow hot-rolled-coil sales address, named email and telephone published alongside product.

suppliers.name: WBW Welser GmbH
suppliers.evidence: Current warm-band range covers DD11-DD14 and structural carbon steels. Homepage explicitly offers hot-strip coils, sheets and slit strip; dimensional availability requires quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Ybbsitz, Austria company address, business email/phone and inquiry form published.

suppliers.name: Clerins Metal SL
suppliers.evidence: Explicit high-purity 99.995% AZSA zinc ingots and jumbo strip. Current allocation, brand documentation and shipment origin must be confirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Humanes de Madrid address, business email, phone and business hours published.

suppliers.name: Norsk Stal AS
suppliers.evidence: Accessible official catalogue explicitly lists hot-rolled coils S355J2+N, S355MC and DD12 pickled/oiled. Individual product-detail routes failed retrieval; no current stock, dimensions or price inferred.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Oslo company address, business telephone/email and customer-registration page inspected. Account approval and export/order acceptance remain unconfirmed.

suppliers.name: SACUH Swiss Trading SA
suppliers.evidence: Public metal-trading page explicitly offers zinc ingots on spot and contract bases, but does not state SHG purity. Minimum 99.995%, brand and assay require confirmation; not a qualified SHG offer.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Lugano headquarters at Via Nassa 36/38, business telephone and Get a Metal Quote route published. Swiss seller location does not establish Swiss shipment origin.

suppliers.name: Dorin Co
suppliers.evidence: Public non-ferrous ingot offering identifies zinc Z1 SHG at minimum 99.995%. Newer trader's self-published claims require legal-entity, assay, mill and export-destination qualification; no allocation confirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Bierbeek, Belgium address, business phone/email and product-inquiry form published. No form submitted and no order acceptance established.

suppliers.name: Nyrstar Belgium — Balen/Pelt
suppliers.evidence: Current SHG ingot page lists Balen SHG and Pelt Z1 products; current operations page identifies Belgian Balen/Pelt production and casting. Request exact product form, assay, mill allocation and origin certificate.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Accessible operations/product pages publish group enquiry telephone and message route. Shared Nyrstar group with Budel, not independent counterparty diversification; no dated sales confirmation.
